4x zoomed 300 DPI crops of the Feb..Mar and Aug..Sep zero-value runs and the Sep..clip-edge run: native cuts the 2.24pt series stroke at its whole-point plot clip (y 391.0) and keeps the grey axis visible below it, while the output paints the full stroke down to 392.31pt. Stroke width, colour, the axis-before-series order and the marker centres match; the native raster marker sprites against vector discs remain accepted shape-edge antialiasing.
